title: Class actions
question: When can one suit bind absent members?

steps.note: Absent members are bound only if adequately represented.
Individual notice to identifiable members, paid for by the plaintiff; no merits preview at certification.
Absent plaintiff class members need notice and an opt-out, not minimum contacts.
A settlement class still needs predominance and adequacy; a sprawling asbestos class fails.
Limited-fund settlement classes need a real limited fund and equitable treatment.
Commonality needs a common contention whose answer drives the resolution.
A named plaintiff cannot stipulate away the class’s damages to defeat CAFA removal.
Every class member seeking damages needs Article III standing.
